description: Source code for a sample application demonstrating how to call the qhull library functions for convex hull, Delaunay triangulation, Voronoi diagram, and halfspace intersection. Contains functions for generating geometric data and a main function executing multiple Qhull operations.

methods.name: print_summary
methods.description: Prints the number of vertices and facets with their normals for a given Qhull data structure.

methods.name: makecube
methods.description: Generates points at vertices of a hypercube.

methods.name: makeDelaunay
methods.description: Generates points for Delaunay triangulation of specified dimension with random coordinates.

methods.name: findDelaunay
methods.description: Finds the Delaunay triangle or adjacent triangle closest to the point [0.5, 0.5, ...].

methods.name: makehalf
methods.description: Generates halfspace coefficients for a diamond shape in specified dimension.
